title.gu: યુનિટ 4 Notes — Tension Member નું Design

h.gu: 4.1 Tension members અને section ની પસંદગી

body.en:
Tension members carry predominantly axial pulling force: truss ties, bracing, hangers and tension chords are examples. Sections include flats, plates, rods, single angles, double angles, channels and other built-up sections. Choose for required strength, connection, length, slenderness, fabrication and corrosion protection. Double angles on opposite sides of a gusset may provide a more balanced load path, but actual connection details and force sharing must be verified.

The factored tensile force Tu must not exceed the smallest applicable design strength. Even when the force is mainly axial, connection eccentricity and shear lag affect an angle connected through one leg. Check the whole assembly, not just gross steel area.
body.gu:
Tension members માં મુખ્યત્વે axial ખેંચાણ હોય છે: truss ties, bracing, hangers અને tension chords ઉદાહરણ છે. Sections માં flats, plates, rods, single angles, double angles, channels અને અન્ય built-up sections છે. જરૂરી strength, connection, length, slenderness, fabrication અને corrosion protection પ્રમાણે પસંદ કરો. Gusset ની બંને બાજુ double angles થી load path વધુ balanced હોઈ શકે, પણ વાસ્તવિક connection details અને force sharing તપાસો.

Factored tensile force Tu લાગુ design strengths માંથી સૌથી નાની કિંમત કરતાં વધુ ન હોવો જોઈએ. Force મુખ્યત્વે axial હોય તોપણ એક leg થી જોડાયેલા angle માં connection eccentricity અને shear lag અસર કરે છે. ફક્ત gross steel area નહીં, સંપૂર્ણ assembly તપાસો.

h.en: 4.2 Gross section yielding and net section rupture
h.gu: 4.2 Gross section yielding અને net section rupture

items.syllabus_item: 4.2 yield and rupture of tension member IS 800

body.en:
Gross yielding: IS 800:2007 clause 6.2 gives Tdg = Ag fy/γm0 for the gross area and specified yield strength. Plate net-section rupture: clause 6.3.1 gives Tdn = 0.9 An fu/γm1. Deduct the correct bolt-hole diameter on each critical section; for staggered paths use the applicable stagger correction and examine all plausible paths. A welded plate without holes is not automatically free from all rupture and connection checks.

Single angle connected by one leg: clause 6.3.3 uses Tdn = 0.9 Anc fu/γm1 + β Ago fy/γm0. Anc is connected-leg net area, Ago gross outstanding-leg area, and β accounts for shear lag according to code geometry and permitted limits. Do not use the plate rupture equation as if both angle legs are directly connected. Double-angle connections require the appropriate code provisions, gusset arrangement and force distribution.
body.gu:
Gross yielding: IS 800:2007 clause 6.2 મુજબ Tdg = Ag fy/γm0 છે, જેમાં Ag gross area અને fy specified yield strength છે. Plate net-section rupture: clause 6.3.1 મુજબ Tdn = 0.9 An fu/γm1 છે. દરેક critical section પર યોગ્ય bolt-hole diameter બાદ કરો; staggered paths માટે લાગુ stagger correction અને બધા સંભવિત paths તપાસો. Hole વગરની welded plate માટે પણ બધી rupture તથા connection checks આપોઆપ રદ થતી નથી.

એક leg થી જોડાયેલ single angle: clause 6.3.3 મુજબ Tdn = 0.9 Anc fu/γm1 + β Ago fy/γm0 છે. Anc connected-leg net area, Ago outstanding-leg gross area અને β code geometry તથા permitted limits મુજબ shear lag દર્શાવે છે. બંને angle legs સીધા જોડાયેલા હોય એમ plate rupture equation ન વાપરો. Double-angle connection માટે લાગુ code provisions, gusset arrangement અને force distribution તપાસો.

h.en: 4.3 Block shear and connection limit states
h.gu: 4.3 Block shear અને connection limit states

body.en:
Block shear occurs when a block around the connection tears along shear plane(s) parallel to force and a tension plane across the end. Trace the actual critical path and determine gross and net shear areas Avg and Avn and gross and net tension areas Atg and Atn. IS 800:2007 clause 6.4.1 requires the smaller of two combinations: shear yielding with tension rupture, and shear rupture with tension yielding. Apply the correct half-hole or full-hole deductions to the actual path and check alternative paths.

Design strength Td is the minimum of gross yielding Tdg, rupture Tdn and applicable block-shear Tdb, together with connection bolt/weld, gusset and detailing checks. Connection capacity is not interchangeable with member gross yielding. Use factored action with design resistance and retain units consistently.
body.gu:
Block shear માં connection આસપાસનો block force ને parallel shear plane(s) તથા છેડે transverse tension plane પર ફાટી શકે છે. વાસ્તવિક critical path દોરી gross/net shear areas Avg અને Avn તથા gross/net tension areas Atg અને Atn શોધો. IS 800:2007 clause 6.4.1 મુજબ બે combinations માંથી ઓછું લો: shear yielding સાથે tension rupture અને shear rupture સાથે tension yielding. વાસ્તવિક path પર યોગ્ય half-hole અથવા full-hole deductions લગાવી alternative paths પણ તપાસો.

Design strength Td = gross yielding Tdg, rupture Tdn અને લાગુ block-shear Tdb માંથી minimum; સાથે connection bolt/weld, gusset અને detailing checks પણ જરૂરી છે. Connection capacity અને member gross yielding એકસરખાં નથી. Factored action ને design resistance સાથે સરખાવો અને units સુસંગત રાખો.

h.en: 4.4 Single and double angle design workflow
h.gu: 4.4 Single અને double angle design ની પ્રક્રિયા

items.syllabus_item: 4.3–4.4 analysis and design angle sections bolted and welded

body.en:
Analysis: read the actual section properties and steel grade; calculate gross yielding, applicable net-section rupture including shear lag, block shear and connection strength. The smallest complete limit-state resistance governs. Check slenderness limits from the relevant IS 800 table for the member’s purpose and loading; tension-only bracing and members subject to stress reversal may have different limits.

Design: select a trial section from SP 6 or current verified tables, calculate its resistances and design bolts or welds for the factored force, including gusset and detailing. Revise the section or connection if any check fails. For double angles, state whether they are on one or opposite sides, whether load is shared equally and how the force reaches each angle; apply appropriate code requirements. A theoretical two-times-single-angle capacity is not proof of a complete double-angle design.
body.gu:
Analysis: Actual section properties અને steel grade લો; gross yielding, shear lag સહિત લાગુ net-section rupture, block shear અને connection strength ગણો. સંપૂર્ણ limit-state resistances માંથી સૌથી ઓછી governing છે. Member ના હેતુ અને loading પ્રમાણે IS 800 table ની slenderness limits તપાસો; tension-only bracing અને stress reversal ધરાવતા members માટે limits જુદી હોઈ શકે છે.

Design: SP 6 અથવા current verified tables માંથી trial section પસંદ કરો, તેની resistances ગણો અને factored force માટે bolts અથવા welds, gusset તથા detailing design કરો. કોઈ check નિષ્ફળ જાય તો section અથવા connection બદલો. Double angles એક બાજુ કે વિરુદ્ધ બાજુ છે, load સમાન વહેંચાય છે કે નહીં અને દરેક angle સુધી force કેવી રીતે પહોંચે છે તે દર્શાવો; યોગ્ય code requirements અનુસરો. Single-angle capacity નો ફક્ત બમણો સંપૂર્ણ double-angle design નો પુરાવો નથી.

title.en: Numerical 4.1 — Plate yielding and net rupture
title.gu: Numerical 4.1 — Plate yielding અને net rupture

body.en:
Given: A plate is 120 mm wide and 10 mm thick with one 22 mm hole on the critical section. Take fy = 250 MPa, fu = 410 MPa, γm0 = 1.10 and γm1 = 1.25. Compare yielding and rupture; block shear and connection checks are not included.

Step 1. Calculate gross and net areas.

Ag = 120 × 10Ag = 1200 mm²An = (120 − 22) × 10An = 980 mm²

Step 2. Find gross yielding strength.

Tdg = Ag fy / γm0Tdg = 1200 × 250 / 1.10Tdg ≈ 272.73 kN

Step 3. Find net rupture strength.

Tdn = 0.9 An fu / γm1Tdn = 0.9 × 980 × 410 / 1.25Tdn = 289.30 kN

Final answer:

The lesser of these two checks is 272.73 kN; complete strength also requires block shear and connection checks.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Plate 120 mm પહોળી અને 10 mm જાડી છે; critical section પર એક 22 mm hole છે. fy = 250 MPa, fu = 410 MPa, γm0 = 1.10 અને γm1 = 1.25 લો. Yielding અને rupture સરખાવો; block shear અને connection checks સામેલ નથી.

Step 1. Gross અને net areas ગણો.

Ag = 120 × 10Ag = 1200 mm²An = (120 − 22) × 10An = 980 mm²

Step 2. Gross yielding strength શોધો.

Tdg = Ag fy / γm0Tdg = 1200 × 250 / 1.10Tdg ≈ 272.73 kN

Step 3. Net rupture strength શોધો.

Tdn = 0.9 An fu / γm1Tdn = 0.9 × 980 × 410 / 1.25Tdn = 289.30 kN

અંતિમ જવાબ:

આ બે checks માં ઓછું 272.73 kN છે; સંપૂર્ણ strength માટે block shear અને connection checks પણ જરૂરી.

title.en: Numerical 4.2 — Single-angle rupture with shear lag
title.gu: Numerical 4.2 — Shear lag સાથે single-angle rupture

body.en:
Given: For a single angle connected through one leg, assume Anc = 400 mm², Ago = 500 mm², β = 1.10, fy = 250 MPa, fu = 410 MPa, γm0 = 1.10 and γm1 = 1.25. Calculate rupture strength; β is supplied after code checks.

Step 1. Write the connected-leg and outstanding-leg expression.

Tdn = 0.9 Anc fu / γm1 + β Ago fy / γm0

Step 2. Calculate each contribution.

Connected-leg term = 0.9 × 400 × 410 / 1.25Connected-leg term = 118.08 kNOutstanding-leg term = 1.10 × 500 × 250 / 1.10Outstanding-leg term = 125.00 kN

Step 3. Add contributions.

Tdn = 118.08 + 125.00

Final answer:

Angle rupture strength = 243.08 kN; yielding, block shear and connection remain to be checked.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: એક leg થી જોડાયેલ single angle માટે Anc = 400 mm², Ago = 500 mm², β = 1.10, fy = 250 MPa, fu = 410 MPa, γm0 = 1.10 અને γm1 = 1.25 ધારો. Rupture strength ગણો; β code checks પછી આપેલ છે.

Step 1. Connected-leg અને outstanding-leg expression લખો.

Tdn = 0.9 Anc fu / γm1 + β Ago fy / γm0

Step 2. દરેક contribution ગણો.

Connected-leg term = 0.9 × 400 × 410 / 1.25Connected-leg term = 118.08 kNOutstanding-leg term = 1.10 × 500 × 250 / 1.10Outstanding-leg term = 125.00 kN

Step 3. Contributions ઉમેરો.

Tdn = 118.08 + 125.00

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Angle rupture strength = 243.08 kN; yielding, block shear અને connection તપાસવાં બાકી છે.

title.gu: Numerical 4.3 — Block shear strength ની ગણતરી

body.en:
Given: Given a properly identified block path: Avg = 900, Avn = 700, Atg = 300 and Atn = 210 mm²; fy = 250 MPa, fu = 410 MPa, γm0 = 1.10 and γm1 = 1.25. Find the two block-shear strengths.

Step 1. Calculate shear yielding plus tension rupture.

Tdb1 = Avg fy / (√3 γm0) + 0.9 Atn fu / γm1Tdb1 = 900 × 250 / (√3 × 1.10) + 0.9 × 210 × 410 / 1.25Tdb1 ≈ 180.09 kN

Step 2. Calculate shear rupture plus tension yielding.

Tdb2 = 0.9 Avn fu / (√3 γm1) + Atg fy / γm0Tdb2 = 0.9 × 700 × 410 / (√3 × 1.25) + 300 × 250 / 1.10Tdb2 ≈ 187.49 kN

Step 3. Adopt the smaller resistance.

Tdb = min(180.09, 187.49)

Final answer:

Block-shear strength ≈ 180.09 kN for the supplied path.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: યોગ્ય રીતે ઓળખેલા block path માટે Avg = 900, Avn = 700, Atg = 300 અને Atn = 210 mm²; fy = 250 MPa, fu = 410 MPa, γm0 = 1.10 અને γm1 = 1.25 છે. બંને block-shear strengths ગણો.

Step 1. Shear yielding સાથે tension rupture ગણો.

Tdb1 = Avg fy / (√3 γm0) + 0.9 Atn fu / γm1Tdb1 = 900 × 250 / (√3 × 1.10) + 0.9 × 210 × 410 / 1.25Tdb1 ≈ 180.09 kN

Step 2. Shear rupture સાથે tension yielding ગણો.

Tdb2 = 0.9 Avn fu / (√3 γm1) + Atg fy / γm0Tdb2 = 0.9 × 700 × 410 / (√3 × 1.25) + 300 × 250 / 1.10Tdb2 ≈ 187.49 kN

Step 3. ઓછી resistance પસંદ કરો.

Tdb = min(180.09, 187.49)

અંતિમ જવાબ:

આપેલ path માટે block-shear strength ≈ 180.09 kN.

title.en: Formulae, methods and key data — Unit 4
title.gu: Formulae, methods અને key data — યુનિટ 4

body.en:
Use applicable gross/net areas and shear-lag rules; strengths are not a substitute for connection checks.

Tdg = Ag fy / γm0Tdn, plate = 0.9 An fu / γm1Tdn, single angle = 0.9 Anc fu / γm1 + β Ago fy / γm0Tdb1 = Avg fy / (√3 γm0) + 0.9 Atn fu / γm1Tdb2 = 0.9 Avn fu / (√3 γm1) + Atg fy / γm0Td = min(Tdg, Tdn, Tdb)
body.gu:
લાગુ gross/net areas અને shear-lag rules વાપરો; strengths connection checks નો વિકલ્પ નથી.

Tdg = Ag fy / γm0Tdn, plate = 0.9 An fu / γm1Tdn, single angle = 0.9 Anc fu / γm1 + β Ago fy / γm0Tdb1 = Avg fy / (√3 γm0) + 0.9 Atn fu / γm1Tdb2 = 0.9 Avn fu / (√3 γm1) + Atg fy / γm0Td = min(Tdg, Tdn, Tdb)

q.en: What is net area?
q.gu: Net area શું છે?

a.en: Area remaining on a critical section after applicable deductions.

q.en: Why deduct a bolt hole?
q.gu: Bolt hole કેમ બાદ કરીએ?

a.en: The hole reduces material on the rupture path.
a.gu: Hole rupture path પર material ઘટાડે છે.

q.en: What is shear lag?
q.gu: Shear lag શું છે?

a.en: Non-uniform force transfer to portions not directly connected.
a.gu: સીધા જોડાયેલા ન હોય તેવા ભાગમાં અસમાન force transfer.

q.en: Which angle areas enter one-leg rupture?
q.gu: One-leg angle rupture માં કયા areas આવે?

a.en: Connected-leg net area and outstanding-leg gross area.
a.gu: Connected-leg net area અને outstanding-leg gross area.

q.en: What is block shear?
q.gu: Block shear શું છે?

a.en: Combined shear and tension failure around a connection.
a.gu: Connection આસપાસ combined shear અને tension failure.

q.en: How many block-shear expressions are compared?

q.en: Can bolt strength alone establish member strength?

a.en: No; member and other connection checks are required.
a.gu: નહીં; member અને અન્ય connection checks જરૂરી છે.

q.en: Why check slenderness in tension?

a.en: To satisfy applicable service and code limits.
